executive_summary: AIM identified a 29.9% overall acquisition rate across 25,000 prospects. The strongest channel by conversion is Email (30.8%), while Enterprise_Expansion leads campaigns at 30.6%. The model recommends 2,664 prospects for high-value outreach and 8,323 for personalized offers. 114 records have elevated gaming risk and should be reviewed before targeting.
insights: The acquisition engine analyzed 25,000 prospects and identified 7,479 conversions, producing an overall conversion rate of 29.9%.
Email is the strongest acquisition channel by conversion rate at 30.8%, with 1,371 conversions.
Email generates the largest aggregate expected net value at $194.74M.
Enterprise_Expansion is the strongest campaign by conversion rate at 30.6%.
Customer segment 0 has the highest observed conversion rate at 83.2%, indicating a concentrated high-propensity audience.
The scoring engine identified 1,186 high-value prospects suitable for focused targeting.
2,664 prospects are currently classified for high-value outreach, while 8,323 are better suited to personalized offers.
114 prospects require gaming-risk review. These records should be screened before aggressive acquisition activity.
actions: Prioritize Email for high-propensity acquisition campaigns.
Evaluate scaling Enterprise_Expansion because it currently has the highest campaign conversion rate.
Use segment 0 as a high-propensity audience for targeted campaigns.
Route 114 gaming-risk records to review rather than direct acquisition.
Use conversion probability and expected business value together instead of propensity alone when prioritizing prospects.
